Container.Name: travelarr
Container.Overview: Sign in with Plex, browse the watchlist, movies and shows on your home Plex server, and copy the original files (plus external subtitles) into this NAS's Media share over HTTPS. Resumes after dropped connections and verifies every resume. Infuse or any player can then play from the share without Plex on the NAS.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port for the travelarr web interface.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Settings, copy history and the Plex sign-in (travelarr.db).

Config.Name: Media share
Config.Description: Where copies land, in the same layout as at home (Movies/..., TV-Shows/...). Local Files can delete anything inside its library folders.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Password for the web interface (any username). Required: after sign-in travelarr holds a Plex token for your account.

Config.Name: Device name
Config.Description: Optional. What the UI calls this NAS (Copy to ..., On ...). Empty uses the Unraid server name.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING or ERROR. Shown under Logs in the Docker tab.
